# RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator & Manifest Training

> RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator & Manifest Training: 3 self-paced online courses from $58.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator & Manifest Training and wants to compare the courses, prices and lengths, or enroll.
- Each course entry below lists the price per seat, the length, the regulation it follows and an enroll link that opens the checkout.
- For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/#course-374): $58.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR 172 Subpart H and EPA RCRA Regulations 40 CFR Part 262 Subpart B. Enroll: https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=374. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Refresher Training](https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/#course-181): $124.99 per person, 4 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with EPA Regulations 40 CFR Part 261 and 40 CFR part 262. Enroll: https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=181. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/#course-114): $134.99 per person, 4 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with EPA Regulations 40 CFR Part 261 and 40 CFR part 262. Enroll: https://rcra-hazardous-waste.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=114. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/rcra-hazwoper-waste-generator
